comment: Source read at commit c13145d. The shift is applied as x << ((s + i) % 16) at clwyd.cpp:86-104. For a negative shift that expression asks for a negative shift count, which C++ leaves undefined; built with clang on arm64 the affected channels read 0 rather than wrapping round, so the rotation is not symmetric about zero. clwyd.cpp:80 holds a commented-out shift_f * 16.f, the scaling the maker replaced with 1.6. The value input is not clamped, so voltages above 10V and below 0V reach the int conversion and set bits the knob cannot.
